newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 11.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia to expand offset programme, crown prince says.
- Pakistani foreign minister says his country does not want confrontation with India.
- First group of Pakistani pilgrims arrives in Jeddah for the annual pilgrimage.
- Saudi Arabian Basic Industries Corp posts 4.4 billion riyal net profit in 1996, down from 6.28 billion riyals in 1995.
- A team of U.S. businessmen to arrive in the kingdom on Tuesday for talks on ways of boosting coopertion.
